tools.name: extract_method
tools.description: Extract selected code into a new private method

sourceCode.description: The complete C# source code containing the code to extract

startLine.description: The starting line number of the code block to extract (1-based)

endLine.description: The ending line number of the code block to extract (inclusive, 1-based)

newMethodName.description: The name for the new extracted method

tools.name: constructor_injection
tools.description: Convert method parameters to constructor-injected fields or properties

className.description: The name of the class to modify

methodName.description: The name of the method containing parameters to inject

parameterNames.description: Comma or semicolon-separated list of parameter names to inject

useProperties.description: If true, create properties instead of fields (optional, default: false)

tools.name: make_field_readonly
tools.description: Make fields readonly where safe (only assigned in constructors)

className.description: The name of the class containing fields

fieldName.description: Optional specific field name, or omit to analyze all fields

tools.name: safe_delete_method
tools.description: Delete methods with reference checking to ensure safe deletion

className.description: The name of the class containing the method

methodName.description: The name of the method to delete

tools.name: extract_class
tools.description: Extract fields and methods into a new class with composition pattern

className.description: The name of the class to extract from

newClassName.description: The name for the new extracted class

memberNames.description: Comma or semicolon-separated list of member names (fields/methods) to extract

tools.name: remove_unused_usings
tools.description: Remove unused using directives with framework-aware global using preservation

tools.name: inline_method
tools.description: Inline a method by replacing its single invocation with the method body (Part 1: void methods, simple parameters, single caller)

className.description: The name of the class containing the method

methodName.description: The name of the method to inline
